boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named destinations on or beside the Route 10/Whitney Avenue corridor connecting Quinnipiac’s Hamden campuses with nearby public recreation, culture, and food stops.

cards.title: Mount Carmel Campus
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Avenue off the Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the university’s digital map to find visitor parking and orient yourself before walking between the academic buildings, library, and student center.
cards.short_summary: Quinnipiac’s main Hamden campus is the corridor’s starting point.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac lists its Mount Carmel Campus at 275 Mount Carmel Avenue and directs Route 10/Whitney Avenue travelers to turn onto Mount Carmel Avenue for campus.
cards.access_notes: Visitor access, parking, and building entry are governed by current university guidance.

cards.title: York Hill Campus
cards.subtitle: Sherman Avenue off the Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Follow Quinnipiac’s directions from Whitney Avenue to Sherman Avenue, then check the campus map for the arena, recreation, and meeting spaces.
cards.short_summary: A second Quinnipiac campus reached directly from the Whitney Avenue route.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac identifies York Hill Campus at 305 Sherman Avenue and gives directions from Route 10/Whitney Avenue to Sherman Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Visitor access, parking, and event entry depend on current university guidance.

cards.title: Sleeping Giant State Park
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Avenue beside the Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a daytime trail visit, select an appropriate route, and review Connecticut DEEP’s current park notices before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A state-park trail destination beside Quinnipiac’s Mount Carmel setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac states that its Mount Carmel Campus is nestled at the foot of Sleeping Giant State Park, and Connecticut DEEP provides official park information.
cards.source_title: Sleeping Giant State Park | Connecticut DEEP
cards.access_notes: Confirm current trail, parking, and closure information with Connecticut DEEP before visiting.

cards.title: Farmington Canal State Park Trail
cards.subtitle: Route 10/Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Enter from a signed Hamden access point and use the paved trail for a daylight walk, roll, or ride while observing posted rules.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use trail with access points along the Whitney Avenue corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Office of Tourism identifies the Farmington Canal State Park Trail in Hamden and lists access along Whitney Avenue and at Todd Street near Route 10.
cards.source_title: Farmington Canal Linear Park | Connecticut Office of Tourism
cards.access_notes: Use signed access points and observe posted trail rules and seasonal conditions.

cards.title: Kelly’s Cone Connection
cards.subtitle: 2538 Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Stop at this named Whitney Avenue ice-cream shop when it is open, and check the business directly for seasonal service details.
cards.short_summary: An ice-cream and food stop on the commercial Whitney Avenue stretch.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Office of Tourism lists Kelly’s Cone Connection at 2538 Whitney Avenue in Hamden and describes its ice cream, food, and seasonal hours.
cards.source_title: Kelly's Cone Connection | Connecticut Office of Tourism
cards.access_notes: Hours and seasonal operations can change; confirm directly before traveling.

cards.title: Ixtapa Grille
cards.subtitle: 2547 Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the posted address as a corridor waypoint, then consult the restaurant directly for its current menu, service, and accessibility details.
cards.short_summary: A family restaurant on Whitney Avenue’s Mount Carmel commercial stretch.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Office of Tourism lists Ixtapa Grille as a family restaurant at 2547 Whitney Avenue in Hamden.
cards.source_title: Ixtapa Grille | Connecticut Office of Tourism
cards.access_notes: Confirm current service and accessibility details directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Glenwood Drive-In
cards.subtitle: 2538 Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use this longstanding roadside food destination as a Whitney Avenue stop, confirming current menu and service information with the business first.
cards.short_summary: A named drive-in food destination on the corridor near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: News 12 Connecticut identifies Glenwood Drive-In at 2538 Whitney Avenue in Hamden.
cards.source_title: Road Trip Connecticut Hot Dog Tour | News 12 Connecticut
cards.access_notes: Confirm current operation and ordering details directly before visiting.

cards.title: Eli’s Brick Oven Pizza & Market
cards.subtitle: 2402 Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s current menu and hours before making this short corridor stop for pizza, calzones, prepared foods, or salads.
cards.short_summary: A pizza-and-market destination on Whitney Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Eli’s Brick Oven Pizza & Market lists its Hamden location at 2402 Whitney Avenue and describes its pizza, calzones, prepared foods, stuffed breads, and salads.
cards.access_notes: Check the official restaurant page for current hours and menu availability.

cards.title: Gallery 4
cards.subtitle: 2985 Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Browse this named Whitney Avenue shop during its posted hours, and confirm current inventory or accessibility details directly before a dedicated trip.
cards.short_summary: A vintage-collectibles and gifts stop on the north Hamden corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Office of Tourism lists Gallery 4 at 2985 Whitney Avenue in Hamden and describes it as offering vintage collectibles, antiques, and gifts.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current opening hours and inventory directly with the shop.

cards.title: Eli Whitney Museum and Workshop
cards.subtitle: 915 Whitney Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a museum visit around its posted schedule, then choose between free admission or a separately priced hands-on program if one is offered.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on learning museum on the southbound Whitney Avenue route.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Office of Tourism lists the Eli Whitney Museum and Workshop at 915 Whitney Avenue, identifies it as a hands-on learning workshop, and states that museum admission is free while programs have separate prices.
cards.source_title: Eli Whitney Museum | Connecticut Office of Tourism
cards.access_notes: Museum admission is listed as free; hands-on programs carry separate listed prices, so check the museum’s current schedule.
